description: Check whether a vendor, invoice sender, or payee is legitimate BEFORE paying it or sharing sensitive data. Checks domain age, look-alike/impersonation domains, email security, HTTPS, website, US sanctions (OFAC) and SEC public-company records. Returns verdict allow | review | block with reasons. If verdict is not allow, do not pay without human confirmation.

email.description: Email address the request or invoice came from

name.description: Company or person name as given on the invoice or request
